A `locals` block uses the plural keyword, but when you reference a local value inside a resource argument you write `local.<NAME>` — singular.
String interpolation in HCL looks like `"${var.foo}-${var.bar}"`. The local value is just that expression assigned to a name inside `locals { ... }`.
The `tags` argument takes a map. For example: `tags = { Project = local.name_prefix }`. Both resources need their own `tags` block referencing the same local.
